name: Argo - Taccuino
subtitle: Digital stenographer, offline
promotionalText: Records the meeting, transcribes it and separates the voices right on your iPhone. The audio is deleted immediately: no recordings on the phone, no cloud.
description:
Argo Taccuino is a digital stenographer for people who meet people: trade fairs, customer visits, quick meetings standing at a booth.

It is not a recorder. It only listens while you use it, transcribes on the iPhone, does not keep the voice and does not send the conversation to any cloud.

WHAT IT DOES
• Records the meeting and transcribes it right on the device
• Separates the voices: you know who said what
• Recognises your voice thanks to your voice profile
• Photographs business cards and documents without stopping the recording, reads the text (OCR) and attaches each photo to the right moment of the conversation
• Deletes the audio as soon as it is transcribed: only text and photos stay on the phone

AND AFTER THE MEETING
• Move your meetings to your Mac with Argo (optional) through the Argo Bridge: encrypted connection on the local network, paired with a QR code
• Or export with AirDrop or to Files
• On iPhones compatible with Apple Intelligence it prepares a first report right on the phone

PRIVACY, FOR REAL
• No account, no advertising, no telemetry
• No data sent to the developer or to third parties
• The text it produces is yours: you decide where it goes

USE IT WITH RESPECT
Before recording, tell the people present. Argo always shows clearly when it is listening.

Requirements: iOS 26, iPhone 11 or later. The report on the phone requires an iPhone with Apple Intelligence; transcription works on all supported models. Reports are currently written in Italian.

Support: supporto@argo-net.it
whatsNew:
Argo now speaks four languages: English, Italian, German and Spanish. It follows the iPhone's language; to choose another one just for Argo: iOS Settings › Argo › Language.

• Long meetings are no longer interrupted when you leave the meeting screen, and the screen stays on while Argo works
• If processing is interrupted anyway, the audio stays on the phone and a message explains how to resume
• New Licenses and acknowledgements section in Settings › About
